statement_blocker: The catalog does not cite an exact source or fix the ambient dimension, ordered and nondegenerate triangle representation, definitions of orthocenter, centroid, and circumcenter, rank versus affine-span collinearity encoding, whether the Euler order and ratio are included, or the equilateral and degenerate boundaries.
